name: isolated-ai-cyber-evaluation-skeleton
description: Non-executable typed skeleton for an isolated AI cyber evaluation platform and range

scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:secrets
scripts.test: npm run test:schemas && npm run test:policy && npm run test:unit && npm run test:api && npm run test:architecture && npm run test:traceability && npm run test:docs
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && node -e 'console.log("PASS TYPE-001 strict TypeScript")' && node --check tests/schemas/test-schemas.mjs && node --check tests/policy/test-policy.mjs && node --check tests/api/test-openapi.mjs && node --check tests/architecture/test-architecture.mjs && node --check tests/architecture/test-non-executable.mjs && node --check tests/architecture/test-docs.mjs && node --check tests/architecture/test-secrets.mjs && node --check tests/traceability/test-phase-02-traceability.mjs
